name: certora-skills
description: Certora agent skills for formal verification of smart contracts and Solana programs.

plugins.name: certora-autoprover
plugins.description: End-to-end formal verification of a Solidity contract with the Certora Prover. Given a project (Foundry/Hardhat) and a main contract, this skill analyzes the system's components, runs certora-autosetup to build a working prover configuration and summaries, formulates security properties (invariants, safety properties, attack vectors) per component, formalizes them in CVL, and iterates certoraRun until every rule is verified, excused as a suspected bug, or skipped with justification — ending with a verification report.

plugins.name: certora-autoprover-solana
plugins.description: End-to-end formal verification of a Solana program with the Certora Solana Prover. Given an Anchor or solana-program crate, this skill analyzes the program's instructions and accounts, scaffolds a CVLR harness into the crate behind a cargo feature, formulates security properties (invariants, safety properties, attack vectors) per component, formalizes them as CVLR rules, and iterates the prover until every rule is verified, excused as a suspected bug, or skipped with justification — ending with a verification report.
